intro.fr: Vacation Simulator se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Vacation Simulator can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Owlchemy Labs sort Vacation Simulator en 2019.
text.en: Owlchemy Labs releases Vacation Simulator in 2019.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, vacation_simulator_0.0.3.
text.en: The first version, vacation_simulator_0.0.3, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version vacation_simulator_0.0.5, la plus récente des 3 versions au nom du jeu sur ce dépôt au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version vacation_simulator_0.0.5 is released, the latest of the 3 versions named after the game on this repository as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: Vacation Simulator figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Vacation Simulator is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
